svg.title: Maknae service architecture
svg.desc: UML 2.5.1 deployment view of Maknae installed on a host as system services: each service's account and trust plane, and which flows are built, proposed or vision.
svg.text: UML 2.5.1 deployment view · What runs on the host, under which account, in which trust plane, and what may talk to what?

Solid = built. Dashed = proposed or post-mvp: designed, no code. Dotted = vision: NO ADR and NO code, unratified. The Agent Daemon is built (#629): one instance per enrolled agent, under the agent's own account, logging in to

Vault with its own AppRole and reaching maknaed only on the agent socket. Tool containers are proposed: decided by ADR-0036, not built; the CLI and the Agent Daemon launch them after a kernel decision. A direct-model
interactive TUI, direct prompt delivery to the Egress Daemon, and shared and dedicated modes are vision.

HOST SERVICES. Maknae installs from rpm, deb and the macOS .pkg as system services, each under its own account: systemd on Linux, launchd on macOS. The only containers drawn are tool invocations, decided by ADR-0036 and not

yet built; the OCI Dockerfiles in packaging/oci are a deferred stub (#81). A containerized deployment (Compose or Kubernetes) is a possible future option, designed in design/container-architecture.md; this view is the

Built today: the maknae CLI, maknaed under _maknae and maknae-egress under _maknae-egress, with root-owned config and an append-only audit trail. maknaed logs in to Vault with its own AppRole and has its plane certificate signed; each

user's CLI logs in with userpass (`maknae login`) and mints its cli leaf with the user's token (not requested by `maknaed`; removed by #116), and the Egress Daemon has no Vault identity: the shipped model, which ADR-0006 supersedes in

target (ADR-0005 amendment). Shipped code still relays prompt content through maknaed: the CLI sends each session.prompt turn to maknaed, which forwards it to maknae-egress. Direct delivery to the Egress Daemon, with maknaed issuing

only the grant, is vision. ADR-0023 (Proposed) decides that the loop is untrusted and is maknae -p, and that a separate Rust egress process under _maknae-egress makes the model call at the kernel's direction. None of its decisions

ratifies tool containers, a direct-model interactive TUI, direct prompt delivery, or shared/dedicated modes; tool containers are decided by ADR-0036 (not built). The Agent Daemon (maknae-agentd, #629) runs one instance per enrolled

agent under the agent's own account (systemd maknae-agent@<id>, launchd io.maknae.maknae-agentd.<id>), confined by its own SELinux domain or a shared AppArmor profile; it logs in with the agent's AppRole, has its agent leaf signed,
claims kernel-signed tasks on the agent socket and works each in its tasker's partition of its home, with every request decided by maknaed.
